name: Phantom Queen
gmNotes: Phantom Queen is a title archetype held by the ruler of a Fey court. Morrigan is the current Phantom Queen. A title does not imply the holder's Species — record the holder's Species and archetypes on their character file rather than assuming from the title. The protected secret is that Morrigan is the human Rioghnach: never expose her human origin in player-facing material. The title grants no automatic mechanics.
description: A queen of the Otherworld known as the Phantom — a figure of rumor and dread whose court deals in debts, secrets, and the cost of promises.
